summary: Iteration 64 - Comprehensive E2E testing of Insights page widgets, Profile Settings, My Income page, and cron job endpoints. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all widgets rendering correctly. Key fix verified: ICICI FD Account correctly classified as semi_liquid (not liquid).

Personality Evolution widget shows chart after 2+ monthly evaluations, otherwise shows single entry
Red Zone theme only activates when survivalDays < 30 (test user has 329 days, so not active)
My Income page - 'Received' amount is visible in white text on green background (not invisible)
Profile Settings at /settings/profile shows DOB, Phone, Marital Status, Employment Type correctly
Weekly digest cron endpoint (POST /api/intelligence/weekly-digest) working correctly
Personality history cron endpoint (GET /api/intelligence/personality-history) working correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Insights page widgets tested and working. Key APIs: (1) GET /api/intelligence/survival-clock - returns 20 stages, fundBreakdown with liquid/semiLiquid/illiquid, ICICI FD is semi_liquid. (2) GET /api/intelligence/control-score - returns finalScore, grade, 4-pillar breakdown. (3) GET /api/intelligence/money-pattern - returns personality, zone, confidence, spendingDNA. (4) GET /api/intelligence/future-you - returns 12-month projections. (5) POST /api/intelligence/shock-test - accepts scenarioId or customAmount. (6) GET /api/intelligence/personality-history - returns evolution history. (7) POST /api/intelligence/weekly-digest - creates weekly snapshot. Profile Settings at /settings/profile (not /profile-settings). My Income at /my-income shows Received/Yet to Receive visible.
